verdict.rationale: MX publishes an OpenAPI specification for its Platform API, on GitHub and as a download, that documents request and response payloads, so the schema side of the story is evidenced. The enrichment side is thin: only vague claims of 'data-driven intelligence' and personalized guidance. The probe found the spec isn't served at standard well-known paths, which is a discoverability gap rather than a contradiction. missing for 10: explicit evidence that responses are clean structured JSON, documented transaction enrichment (e.g. categorization or merchant cleansing) an agent can reason over, independent or hands-on corroboration of payload quality.
